system.description: “Simulation, give me something good / God's creation, so misunderstood”

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v2.0 Mind

backgroundQuestions: Who first showed you how to bend technology beyond its intended purpose — and what flaw in their approach do you now refuse to repeat?
One of your constructs or systems backfired. What went wrong — and why haven't you shut it down permanently?
What ambitious design remains half-finished in your workshop — and what terrifies you about completing it?
Whose research or blueprints do you secretly draw from — and what excuse would you give if they caught you?
What guiding principle shapes every system you build — and what crisis could force you to abandon it?
connections: You once helped me test a prototype in the field. What went wrong — and why did you forgive me?
I built something specifically for you. What is it, and why do you still rely on it?
What aspect of my theories or schematics baffles you completely — but you pretend to understand for my sake?
You know how much I've changed since the accident. Why do you never mention it?
I once asked you to erase or destroy one of my systems. Why didn't you?
